findings.detail: Every visible statistical row must map to the declared columns
Technical traceability must be available in a collapsed layer
Visible blocks need an explicit incremental value decision
Statistical cards must allow omission of generic impact copy
Data evidence must link to an official source
June 2026 audit must include accreditation, mediation, complaints and RNPI
All four official June 2026 bulletin PDFs must be traceable
Stock, cumulative flow and monthly flow must be labelled separately

limitations: Semantic/legal accuracy is not certified by deterministic checks.
Browser evidence is required separately for desktop/mobile.
Statistics checks validate declared schema, units, denominators and traceability; they do not replace subject-matter validation of source publications.
